decisions: Exact-class source supplies the three word-picture objectives; supplementary university language forms are not a Primary4 syllabus or adoption record.

Two original SVGs provide six schematic referents; no copied source image, unseen picture or learner photograph. Both assets rendered and visually inspected, including a corrected book/table position.
Object recognition/describing, word identification, matching, error correction, captioning and observation versus inference are distinct practice routes; no one-question-per-object padding.
No answer words printed in learner images. Teacher manifest contains reference mapping and must not be shown as the learner stimulus.

Text-only alternatives change the visual construct; record accommodations without claiming equivalent observed visual recognition. App/print/accessibility delivery and full referent range remain open.
One spoken task requires actual live/recorded speech and one pointing task requires observed marking/pointing. No actual learner performance occurred.
Native labels/variants and grading remain pending; previous excursion/unit/sound/number-range, local season/culture, adoption and academic-review gaps preserved.
